```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# Read the file
lines <- read_lines("biosample_result.txt")

# Convert to tibble with line numbers
df <- tibble(line = seq_along(lines), text = lines)

# Mark start of each record
df <- df %>%
  mutate(record_id = cumsum(str_detect(text, "^\\d+: ")))

# Collapse each record into one string
records <- df %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>%
  summarise(record_text = paste(text, collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop")

# Keep only human metagenome: saliva
saliva_records <- records %>%
  filter(str_detect(record_text, "Human Metagenome:Saliva"))

# Extract relevant fields
saliva_parsed <- saliva_records %>%
  mutate(
    Record = str_extract(record_text, "^\\d+"),
    GeographicLocation = str_extract(record_text, "/geographic location=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                          str_remove("/geographic location=\"") %>%
                          str_remove("\""),
    Age     = str_extract(record_text, "/host age=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                str_remove("/host age=\"") %>%
                str_remove("\""),
    Sex     = str_extract(record_text, "/host sex=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                str_remove("/host sex=\"") %>%
                str_remove("\""),
    BMI     = str_extract(record_text, "/host body mass index=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                str_remove("/host body mass index=\"") %>%
                str_remove("\""),
    Disease = str_extract(record_text, "/host disease=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                str_remove("/host disease=\"") %>%
                str_remove("\""),
    Height  = str_extract(record_text, "/host height=\"[^\"]+\"") %>%
                str_remove("/host height=\"") %>%
                str_remove("\""),
    Description = str_extract(record_text, "Description:[^\n]*") %>%
                    str_remove("Description:"),
    Accession = str_extract(record_text, "Accession: \\S+") %>%
                  str_remove("Accession: ")
  ) %>%
  select(Record, GeographicLocation, Age, Sex, BMI, Disease, Height, Description, Accession)

head(saliva_parsed)
dim(saliva_parsed)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Add flags for each disease
disease_flags <- saliva_parsed %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease)) %>%
  mutate(

  summarise(
    only_periodontitis = sum(has_periodontitis & !has_caries),
    only_caries       = sum(has_caries & !has_periodontitis),
    both              = sum(has_periodontitis & has_caries)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Create flags for periodontitis, caries, and other diseases
disease_flags <- saliva_parsed %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease)) %>%
  mutate(
    has_periodontitis = str_detect(Disease, "Periodontitis"),
    has_caries       = str_detect(Disease, "Dentin Caries"),
    has_other        = !str_detect(Disease, "Periodontitis|Dentin Caries") # any other disease
  )

# Strict categories: only count samples with *no other disease*
strict_summary <- disease_flags %>%
  filter(!has_other) %>%  # exclude any sample that contains other diseases
  summarise(
    only_periodontitis = sum(has_periodontitis & !has_caries),
    only_caries       = sum(has_caries & !has_periodontitis),
    both              = sum(has_periodontitis & has_caries)
  )

strict_summary

```

```{r}

# Create flags for periodontitis, caries, and other diseases
disease_flags <- saliva_parsed %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease)) %>%
  mutate(
    has_periodontitis = str_detect(Disease, "Periodontitis"),
    has_caries       = str_detect(Disease, "Dentin Caries"),
    has_other        = !str_detect(Disease, "^(Periodontitis|Dentin Caries)(\\|Periodontitis|\\|Dentin Caries)*$") 
    # TRUE if there is any disease outside periodontitis/caries
  ) %>%
  filter(!has_other)  # keep only rows with no other diseases

# Count each category
strict_counts <- disease_flags %>%
  summarise(
    only_periodontitis = sum(has_periodontitis & !has_caries),
    only_caries       = sum(has_caries & !has_periodontitis),
    both              = sum(has_periodontitis & has_caries)
  )

strict_counts
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

result_data_frames <- list()

# Define the target string to search for : # 33 saliva biosamples
target_string <- "Organism: human oral metagenome"

# Detect rows containing the target string
rows_with_target <- which(str_detect(original_df$V1, target_string))
length(rows_with_target)

# Loop through the indices and create new data frames
for (index in rows_with_target) {
  # Ensure that we have all data for one biosample
  if (index - 2 >= 1 && index + 17 <= nrow(original_df)) {
    # Extract the desired rows and store in a new data frame
    new_df <- original_df[(index - 2):(index + 17), ]
    
    # Append the new data frame to the list
    result_data_frames[[length(result_data_frames) + 1]] <- new_df
  }
}
```

```{r}
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(line = row_number()) %>%
  # new sample starts when line matches pattern
  mutate(sample_block = cumsum(str_detect(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from"))) %>%
  # keep only lines we care about
  filter(str_detect(x, "Saliva sample from|Identifiers:|Accession:")) %>%
  mutate(
    key = case_when(
      str_detect(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from") ~ "age",
      str_detect(x, "^Identifiers:") ~ "identifiers",
      str_detect(x, "^Accession:") ~ "accession"
    ),
    value = case_when(
      key == "age" ~ str_remove(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from "),
      key == "identifiers" ~ str_remove(x, "^Identifiers: "),
      key == "accession" ~ str_remove(x, "^Accession: ")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample_block, key, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value)
```

```{r}
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(line = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(sample_block = cumsum(str_detect(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from"))) %>%
  filter(str_detect(x, "Saliva sample from|Identifiers:|Accession:")) %>%
  mutate(
    key = case_when(
      str_detect(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from") ~ "age",
      str_detect(x, "^Identifiers:") ~ "identifiers",
      str_detect(x, "^Accession:") ~ "accession"
    ),
    value = case_when(
      key == "age" ~ str_remove(x, "^\\d+: Saliva sample from "),
      key == "identifiers" ~ str_remove(x, "^Identifiers: "),
      key == "accession" ~ str_remove(x, "^Accession: ")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample_block, key, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value) %>%
  # separate identifiers into clean fields
  separate_wider_regex(
    identifiers,
    patterns = c(
      "BioSample: " = ".*?BioSample: (\\S+)",
      "; Sample name: " = ".*?Sample name: (\\S+)",
      "; SRA: " = ".*?SRA: (\\S+)"
    ),
    names = c("biosample", "sample_name", "sra")
  )
```

```{r}
# Create an empty dataframe to store the extracted information
library(stringr)
new_df1 <- data.frame(age = character(), disease_status = character(), sex = character(), accession = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate through each row of the original dataframe
for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  row <- df$x[i]
  if (str_detect(row, "^    /host age=")) {
    new_row <- data.frame(age = gsub("^    /host age=", "", row),
                          disease_status = NA,
                          sex = NA,
                          accession = NA)
    new_df1 <- rbind(new_df1, new_row)
  } else if (str_detect(row, "^    /host disease=")) {
    new_df1[nrow(new_df1), "disease_status"] <- gsub("^    /host disease=", "", row)
  } else if (str_detect(row, "^    /host sex=")) {
    new_df1[nrow(new_df1), "sex"] <- gsub("^    /host sex=", "", row)
  } else if (str_detect(row, "^Accession: ")) {
    new_df1[nrow(new_df1), "accession"] <- gsub("^Accession: ", "", row)
  }
}
```
